+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _valid_email(value) -> str | None:
+    """Return the trimmed email if it is well formed, otherwise ``None``."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    email = value.strip()
+    if email.count("@") != 1:
+        return None
+    local, domain = email.split("@")
+    if not local:
+        return None
+    if "." not in domain or domain.startswith(".") or domain.endswith("."):
+        return None
+    return email
+
+
+def handle_find_user_by_email(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    email = _valid_email(params.get("email"))
+    if email is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid email"}
+    user = users.find_by_email(email)
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
